Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFU2 project">The games's events happen in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''The Force Unleashed II'' comic]].</ref> a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] '''gladiator''' fought in the [[Tarko-se Arena]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. He and [[Frank]] charged at the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], who had been imprisoned in the arena by [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se's]] ruler, [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]]. The two gladiators were struck down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Kota's lightsaber. This gladiator carried a large mace at the time of his death.<ref name="TFU2 Wii" />

==Behind the scenes==
This gladiator appears in the opening cinematic of [[2010]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' for the Nintendo [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]]. That version differs from the [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]]/[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] versions, which more closely follow the "official" version of ''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' in the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|novel]]. Only Frank appears in the other version, leaving this Weequay's existence murky.
